state_authority: This file is a control-plane contract; live repository identity/HEAD must be resolved from the executing Git repository at validation time.
mission: Make it dramatically easier for an ordinary human with a meaningful vision to accomplish extraordinary things with AI without becoming an AI project manager.

verified_evidence.rule: Only evidence linked in PROOF.json and current receipts may support VERIFIED claims.

unknown: exact internal Vercel failing step beyond the exposed build-rate-limit target; current GitHub evidence does not expose provider build logs
fresh successful control-plane validator result after the current control-plane documentation changes
external LLM cold-start behavioral proof beyond repository-level acceptance
production proof unless a current production runtime observation exists
failures: Current HEAD f425b34331cb55841f7ed63e87b69e784a2764bc has a GitHub Vercel status failure whose target identifies a build-rate-limit condition. GitHub currently exposes no Actions workflow run for this SHA. Historical failed GitHub Actions checks on prior commit b828fa86... are not treated as current-head failures.
risks: Legacy .naya/memory/STATE.json may contain a recorded current_main.commit that becomes stale as main advances; it must not outrank live Git HEAD.
Machine validation is repository-local and does not itself prove external provider behavior.
Automation failures without retrievable job evidence must remain UNKNOWN rather than being guessed or silently repaired.
bottleneck: Obtain a fresh retrievable current-head deployment/automation result after the Vercel build-rate-limit condition is cleared; do not invent a repository repair without repository-side evidence.
single_next_action: Obtain the next fresh Vercel deployment result for current HEAD f425b34331cb55841f7ed63e87b69e784a2764bc after the reported build-rate-limit condition is no longer blocking. If fresh evidence identifies a repository-side divergence, repair only that first cause and rerun the affected gate; if it remains an external provider capacity failure, preserve UNKNOWN for the internal cause and record the provider evidence.
next_actions: Obtain the next fresh Vercel deployment result for current HEAD f425b34331cb55841f7ed63e87b69e784a2764bc after the reported build-rate-limit condition is no longer blocking. If fresh evidence identifies a repository-side divergence, repair only that first cause and rerun the affected gate; if it remains an external provider capacity failure, preserve UNKNOWN for the internal cause and record the provider evidence.
truth_rules: LIVE authoritative source outranks recorded state.
A block is not VERIFIED without claim-appropriate evidence.
Exactly one highest-value next action is exposed.
One-Shot means pursue the strongest correct result now; it never permits guessing, skipped verification, unsafe action, or unsupported repair.
A successor handoff is incomplete unless the next Naya can execute the next action from durable state without reconstructing the prior conversation.
